Emmanuel Carre · The story so far

Three homes.
One voice.

Born in Cameroon. Raised in France. Based in South Florida. Every stop left a mark on the comedy.

Cameroon→France→South Florida→The stage

Different places. One very specific point of view.

Emmanuel Carre turns the collisions between cultures, generations, and relationships into fast, physical comedy. After a heart condition changed the course of his collegiate soccer career, the stage became his new pitch.

His characters draw on African family life, dating, and everyday misunderstandings. What began on screen now comes alive in front of a crowd.
